title: Mall of America®: Crayola Experience
includes: Valid for one admission to Crayola Experience.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore a world of color and creativity at Crayola Experience Mall of America. Jump between 25+ hands-on activities designed to spark your imagination. Create a Crayola crayon with your name on it, turn a personalized coloring page into a 4D adventure, see how crayons are made, and much more!
